en.title: Selectivity in investments will increase
en.summary: Following a fund incident, investors are expected to become more selective and seek safer options. A shift toward deposits has already begun, while interest in foreign currency remains limited and demand for gold shows no clear signs.

stories.title: Her masanın/ her ortamın gündeminde onlar var

en.title: They are on the agenda of every table and every setting
en.summary: Mustafa Sandal is the subject of widespread discussion across various social settings and conversations.

en.title: Be ashamed from Yaşar
en.summary: An AKP prominent figure Metin Külünk responded to fund speculators by invoking the image of young Yaşar in criticism.

stories.title: Vicdanın sesi olan AKP’li vekil Sözcü’ye konuştu: Dokunulmazlar uğruna ülkeyi krize soktular

en.title: AKP deputy with conscience speaks to Sözcü: They pushed the country into crisis for the untouchables
en.summary: An AKP lawmaker claims that selective enforcement of investigations and protection of certain individuals contributed to the country's financial crisis.

en.title: 18.1 million for friendly match
en.summary: A municipality in Konya allocated 18.1 million towards a friendly football match between the Palestinian national team and local club Konyaspor, rather than directing funds toward aid for children in Gaza.

en.title: 'Those responsible must be held accountable'
en.summary: Families who lost relatives in a hotel fire in Bolu Kartalkaya held a justice vigil in Ankara, demanding accountability from those responsible for the incident.

en.title: 'We will not stay silent, we will get our rights!'
en.summary: Retirees from across the country gathered to demand pension increases, while their legal case seeking additional compensation remains pending in appeals court for 1.5 years.

en.title: They watch as it inflates and deflates
en.summary: A growing fund crisis is causing losses for hundreds of thousands of small investors, with total market losses continuing to increase as stock prices fluctuate.

stories.title: Financial Times böyle yazdı: Erdoğan olumsuz etkilenecek

en.title: Financial Times wrote thus: Erdoğan will be negatively affected
en.summary: A fund scandal affecting Turkey since early September, involving AKP-affiliated officials, has attracted international attention including coverage by the Financial Times.

en.title: Billion-dollar suspects in stock exchange scandal
en.summary: Twenty additional people were arrested in a fund investigation that shook capital markets, with the case involving transactions worth billions.

stories.title: Beylikdüzü Devlet Hastanesi’nde yemek boykotu: 30’dan fazla çalışan rahatsızlandı

en.title: Food boycott at Beylikdüzü State Hospital: More than 30 employees fell ill
en.summary: Over 30 workers at Beylikdüzü State Hospital became ill after meals served on September 28-30. Four unions plan a full cafeteria boycott on October 5, demanding independent inspection of food safety and hygiene conditions.

stories.title: Devlet hastanesinde 30'dan fazla kişi zehirlendi, çalışanlar isyan etti

en.title: More than 30 people poisoned at state hospital, employees rebelled
en.summary: Over 30 employees at Beylikdüzü State Hospital became ill following meals. Four unions have organized a response to address the food safety incident.

stories.title: Irak, Hürmüz Boğazı’ndan 2 milyon varil petrol taşıdı

en.title: Iraq transported 2 million barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iraq's state oil tanker company transported 2 million barrels of crude oil through the Strait of Hormuz via a large oil tanker, marking the first such shipment in decades.

stories.title: Ferhat Gündoğdu MHK Başkanlığı görevinden istifa etti

en.title: Ferhat Gündoğdu resigned from his position as head of the Central Referee Board
en.summary: Five people, including Ferhat Gündoğdu, were detained and subsequently arrested in connection with an investigation into referees. Gündoğdu resigned as Central Referee Board chairman and another official resigned from his board membership.

stories.title: Pezeşkiyan: Ekonomik baskı arttı, hedeflerine ulaşmalarına izin vermedik

en.title: Pezeshkian: Economic pressure increased, we prevented them from reaching their goals
en.summary: Iran's president stated that economic pressure has intensified due to US maritime blockade and rising currency rates, but claimed his government's measures prevented adversaries from achieving their objectives in economic warfare.

stories.title: Altın Koza'da ödüller sahiplerini buldu: En İyi Film "Bir Arada Yalnız"

en.title: Golden Boll awards find their recipients: Best Film "Alone Together"
en.summary: At the International Adana Golden Boll Film Festival, the Best Film and Best Director awards in the national feature film competition went to Ali Vatansever's film "Alone Together".

en.title: England defeated Croatia 7-0
en.summary: England defeated Croatia 7-0 in a UEFA Nations League match played away, recording a historic victory.
